name: classic-city-core/framed-callout
title: Framed Callout
description: Full-width hero / CTA section. Outer container holds a uniform padding 'frame' on all four sides; the inner panel inside that frame carries the bg color/gradient (Gutenberg native picker), an optional bg image, and a constrained-narrow InnerBlocks stack (eyebrow + h1 + paragraph + CTA button) vertically centered and left- or center-aligned.
